title: Panthers DL Tershawn Wharton had neck surgery, likely to open camp on PUP list

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Panthers DL Tershawn Wharton had neck surgery, likely to open camp on PUP list
sources.description: Panthers defensive lineman Tershawn Wharton is going to need to recover from neck surgery before he's ready to get back on the field.
